publisher: Ordnance Survey via public ArcGIS feature service
evidence_slice: Ordnance Survey OS OpenMap Local documentation states that generalised building geometries are derived from OS MasterMap large-scale data and that the product contains important buildings. The public OS OpenMap Local Important Buildings feature layer declares esriGeometryPolygon geometry and record fields DISTNAME, BUILDGTHEM and CLASSIFICA, with Ordnance Survey Crown copyright. The selected Exeter bbox first-50 feature query itself could not be retrieved, so no record-level polygon or type/use values were read.

field_evidence.footprint: Layer metadata declares Geometry Type esriGeometryPolygon; OS official documentation states generalised building geometries are derived from OS MasterMap large-scale data.
field_evidence.type_use: Layer metadata exposes DISTNAME (Distinctive Name), BUILDGTHEM (Building Theme), and CLASSIFICA (Classification) on the same important-building feature.
field_evidence.retrieval: The distinct Exeter bbox first-50 feature query could not be retrieved through the web channel; direct network resolution also failed before any feature payload was read.
